purpose: Teach: 引き取り/製法/未納/受け皿/賭ける/画策/押し付ける/強いる

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 前任者の案件、本気で、絶対、引き取り、絶対、ご対応、絶対、お願いします
lines.en: We need to take over the previous project manager's cases. Please handle this seriously — it's essential.
lines.style: Direct, clipped pace. Short breath between demands. A quiet urgency underneath the formality. Lean forward slightly on the key asks.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社製品の、本気で、絶対、製法、絶対、改良、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're actively improving our product's manufacturing process. I appreciate your trust in us.
lines.style: Steady, measured cadence. Slight pause after the opening phrase. Warm attentiveness — showing he's heard the weight of the request. Slight bow in the voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お得意様の、本気で、絶対、未納、絶対、状況、絶対、確認、絶対、お願いします
lines.en: We need to verify the payment status of our key clients right away. Can you look into that?
lines.style: Purposeful tempo. Clean attack on each new topic. Concerned but not panicked — this is urgent housekeeping, not crisis. Brief downward inflection at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様意見の、本気で、絶対、受け皿、絶対、ホットライン、絶対、開設しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Of course. We've set up a dedicated customer feedback hotline to address concerns promptly. We're grateful for the opportunity to improve.
lines.style: Confident, clear diction. Slight lift on the announcement of the new system. Genuine — not performing compliance, but showing action taken. Warm closing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新規事業、本気for、絶対、賭ける、絶対、価値、絶対、ありますね
lines.en: The new venture has real potential. It's worth the commitment, don't you think?
lines.style: Thoughtful opening. Slower pace than before, inviting reflection. Soft questioning lilt at the end — genuinely soliciting his view, not rhetorical. Gentle conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。販売戦略の、本気で、絶対、画策、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're working to refine our sales strategy carefully. Thank you for your leadership on this.
lines.style: Clear, engaged delivery. Tempo matches the seriousness of the topic. Slight warmth on the closing phrase — acknowledging her vision without overselling. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員に責任を、本気で、絶対、押し付ける、絶対、ような、絶対、管理、絶対、避けましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we're not putting unfair pressure on our people. Good management protects them from that.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Measured pace with deliberate weight on 'protects.' This is a principle being stated, not criticism. Slight downward inflection — a conclusion she's reached.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。無理を、本気で、絶対、強いる、絶対、ない、絶対、業務体制、絶対、整えております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Absolutely. We're restructuring our workload so no one is forced to work unreasonably. We're committed to that standard.
lines.style: Assured closing. Solid, grounded tone. Not defensive — just clear about values. Final phrase lands with quiet conviction. A small nod in the voice.
